{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print('\nCount of -1 in customer_age:', (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print('\nUnique revenue values (first 10):', df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check status column
print('\nUnique values in status:', df['status'].unique())

# Check for QA orders
print('\nRows with revenue == 999999.99:', (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
